verdict.rationale: Ironclad supports webhooks to trigger outbound notifications on events and an API/Workflows API to programmatically launch or update workflows, plus integrations that can block/push forward approvals automatically — this gives event-driven automation. However there's no evidence of a native rules engine where AI-native users can define arbitrary conditional 'if event then action' automations without building custom integration code. Missing for 10: a first-class rules/automation builder, documented trigger-condition-action configuration UI, and independent confirmation of automated rule execution in practice.
